title: crotalaria huillensis
intro: Crotalaria huillensis, commonly known as Huillensis Bush Clover, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria huillensis include its ability to relieve pain and reduce fever, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant are still being studied, but it is known to contain alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
